sentences.text: Other required equipment includes navigation lights and sound-signaling equipment that meet the Navigation Rules, the oil discharge and garbage placards on boats twenty-six feet and over, and a Coast Guard certified marine sanitation device if you have an installed toilet.
Before every trip, brief your passengers on where the life jackets are, how to put them on, and what to do in an emergency.
Beyond the minimum, a professional captain carries a registered EPIRB or personal locator beacon, a VHF radio with DSC, a well-stocked first aid kit, and reliable bilge pumps with a high-water alarm.
